decision_explanation: No branch can be selected yet -- per the hard constraints this decision must be based entirely on observed leaderboard probe scores. Still missing: Stage1 (Probe B / C1 and the LLM-Stage1 probe leaderboard scores); Stage2 (Probe A / G, the LLM-Stage2 probe, AND Probe C for the M1_trivial reference -- see 104.0).

all_branch_explanations.Branch A:
### Branch A -- Classical wins both stages

Neither C1 nor G is beaten by the LLM on the leaderboard. Recommendation: keep the classical production pipeline unchanged; treat the LLM pathway as a research/audit tool only (per H11 Part 3), not a production candidate.
all_branch_explanations.Branch B:
### Branch B -- LLM wins Stage1 only

The LLM beats C1 on Stage1 but G still beats the LLM on Stage2. Recommendation: evaluate the 'LLM Stage1 + G Stage2' hybrid candidate (107.0) as the new production submission, keeping G unchanged.
all_branch_explanations.Branch C:
### Branch C -- LLM wins Stage2 only

The LLM beats G on Stage2 but C1 still beats the LLM on Stage1. Recommendation: evaluate the 'C1 Stage1 + LLM Stage2' hybrid candidate (107.0), keeping C1 unchanged.
all_branch_explanations.Branch D:
### Branch D -- LLM wins both stages

The LLM beats both C1 and G. Recommendation: a full LLM-based production pipeline becomes the primary candidate, but should still be validated for cost/latency at full-scale (615-row) inference before replacing the classical pipeline outright.
